plain_english: Of one who neither meditates nor chants, manifestation may come without any preparatory rule. Just so — O light of Śiva — we bow to him who possesses devotion.
sanskrit_cite: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam | evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam

plain_english: My self stays young, drinking the nectar of Your devotion — though greyed as if with the dust of worldly journeying and its passions.
sanskrit_cite: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san | lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ

plain_english: For those who have gained that wealth — the possessors of devotion dwelling in Your city — even movement along worldly paths happens by that very expansion.
sanskrit_cite: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām | saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā

plain_english: Lord — where the whole world within worlds directly consists of You, what is not the devotee's field, and whose mantra does not succeed?
sanskrit_cite: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare | kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati

plain_english: Victory to those intoxicated with the finest wine of devotion's nectar-essence! Though non-dual, they are ever Your second, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ | advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho

plain_english: Lord of the ocean of endless bliss — only they know Your truth who are densely drenched in blissful devotion's nectar.
sanskrit_cite: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te | tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ

plain_english: You alone, Lord of the self, are the nature of all, and all loves dwelling in the self. Knowing Your devotion as self-established, may a person conquer.
sanskrit_cite: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān | iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ

plain_english: Lord — when the knowable is destroyed, by whom are You not seen, standing alone? Even amid the agitation of knower and knowable, You are easily seen by devotees.
sanskrit_cite: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ | vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ

plain_english: As the lake of endless bliss, the Goddess, the beloved, is inseparable from You — so may one devotion of mine be inseparable.
sanskrit_cite: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā | aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me

plain_english: O All-pervading — for devotees of devotion, everything is a cause of gaining You. This path of consciousness stands threefold — in joy, in suffering, in delusion.
sanskrit_cite: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho | saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ

plain_english: What of knowledge — even its supreme state, from tasting Your devotion's nectar — is to me, O Lord, like vinegar-sourness after wine.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā | daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā

plain_english: Those to whom the great knowledge of Your devotion has come through practice — they alone know truth, both knowledge and its absence.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā | vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ

plain_english: From the root, this creeper of speech, unfolding in due sequence — watered by the nectar of Your devotion, may it bear rasa-rich fruit for me.
sanskrit_cite: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī | tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me

plain_english: "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — so the devotee is said to have become. For You alone are the body's essence, purified by devotees through non-duality.
sanskrit_cite: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate | tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam

plain_english: For devotees, what is not a means to accomplishment of non-duality with You? And for the low, what obstructions could there be to its failure?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ | tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā

plain_english: That You are attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga, O Lord — that is the deceit. Otherwise, how would You shine in all states for the possessors of devotion?
sanskrit_cite: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā | anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham

plain_english: Untouched by withdrawal and the rest — this is the great distinction: that sharers of devotion stay composed even in emergence, beyond the yogins.
sanskrit_cite: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam | yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ

plain_english: No yoga is enjoined, no austerity, no procedure of worship at all. On this guileless path of Śiva, devotion alone is praised.
sanskrit_cite: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate | amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate

plain_english: My covering shattered by devotion's light shining from all sides — may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish.
sanskrit_cite: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama | pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

plain_english: A wonder: that in devotees, with the single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue's tip, there is the taste of every sense-object.
sanskrit_cite: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā | samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho

plain_english: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet milk-ocean of devotion's nectar — in tasting its unworldly essence — who that stands firm there is counted low?
sanskrit_cite: śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau | alaukikarasāsvāde susthaiḥ ko 'nāma gaṇyate

plain_english: Why would people like me not chew Your devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste, O Lord, is called liberation?
sanskrit_cite: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ | tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ

plain_english: Those alone are ultimately wealth, O Lord, in the judgement of the good — which nourish confident enjoyment of the taste of devotion to You.
sanskrit_cite: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ | tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

plain_english: They have grasped something of Your devotion-nectar's essence who, though fallen into this mud of passion and the rest, are not smeared by it.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ | ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api

plain_english: From supernormal powers to liberation — fruit is named as a mere limb of the ripened creeper of Your devotion, for some.
sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā | bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit

plain_english: A wonder, Lord: this mind, by nature pain's seed — watered by the essence of devotion to You, becomes liberation's great fruit.
sanskrit_cite: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ | tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam
